sources.author: Fakh
patch_list: Makes Google sign-in work by signing in through microG RE (GmsCore) instead of Google Play services. Needs microG RE installed and signed in to a Google account.
Unlocks the client-side Premium and Premium AI checks and removes ads.
Adds the themed app icon of Android 13 and later, which follows the wallpaper colors.
